Choose a generated app's design

Source: R/design.R
app_design.Rd

Create settings for generate_shiny() or design_app(). Colours must be opaque six-digit hex values. Text and accent colours must have at least 4.5:1 contrast against the page, panels and derived tints. Fonts come from each reader's device and use fallbacks; no author-machine font files are needed. Named fonts may be substituted on other platforms.

Usage

app_design(
  accent = "#096B74",
  background = "#EDF3F7",
  surface = "#FFFFFF",
  text = "#182F46",
  font = "system",
  text_size = 15,
  spacing = "comfortable",
  radius = 10
)

Arguments

accent

Colour for actions, links and primary estimates.

background

Page background colour.

surface

Panel background colour.

text

Main text colour.

font

One of system, arial, verdana or georgia.

text_size

Base interface text size in pixels, from 14 to 20.

spacing

comfortable or compact.

radius

Panel corner radius in pixels, from 0 to 16.

Value

A named list of validated design settings.

Examples

design <- app_design(accent = "#69429A", font = "georgia", radius = 4)
# generate_shiny(dataset, "My analysis", design = design)
